articles.title: Peacemaker with a warning to annihilate: The major contradictions in Trump's UN speech
articles.summary: Trump used much of his address to the General Debate of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly to list his achievements, much as he did a year ago when he cast himself as the standout contender for the Nobel Peace Prize. This year, though, the prize went unmentioned.

articles.title: Karnataka man 'murdered' in UAE, body cut into 9 pieces; wife, son untraceable
articles.summary: A man from Kundapur, Alwin, was reported missing after last contacting his family in July. His family became suspicious after receiving unusual text messages from his phone, which he rarely used.

articles.title: UP man kills wife, 2 priests, takes 3 children hostage; shot dead after 7-hour standoff
articles.summary: A police encounter resulted in the death of Arvind Singh after he refused to surrender during a standoff. During the incident, he was holding his three children hostage, leading to a police operation.

articles.title: LSR cancels classes, goes online after Kalkaji Mandir gang rape case
articles.summary: Lady Shri Ram College cancelled regular classes and shifted them online after a 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped at Aastha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir. Police said three men, posing as policemen, allegedly separated the girl from her male friend and assaulted her in a secluded area.

articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Samantha Ruth Prabhu enjoys pickleball with husband Raj Nidimoru
articles.summary: Samantha Ruth Prabhu is actively enjoying her pregnancy while participating in activities like pickleball with her husband Raj Nidimoru. She has been sharing her fitness routines on social media, emphasizing the importance of listening to her body.

articles.title: Fact Check: Was Komal Rani Swarnkar spotted with sindoor on her head?
articles.summary: Govinda and Komal Rani visited Lalbaugcha Raja in Mumbai for Ganpati darshan amid relationship rumors. Speculation arose after a photo suggested Komal was wearing a sindoor during the visit.

articles.title: Parents unhappy after notice given at Harry and Meghan Markle’s children’s school
articles.summary: Parents at the school attended by Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet have received new photography guidelines. This notice addresses the importance of only taking photos of their own children at events.

articles.title: Tom Cruise never reads his scripts before accepting role
articles.summary: Tom Cruise has opened up about his unique approach to scripts, stating that he has them read aloud to him rather than reading them independently. He argues that this technique helps capture the director's intent and spot potential story flaws.
